Peter Pan’s Library is a very hands-on creative project for me. A great deal of time and care goes into every film. I develop the themes and stories, write the reflections and words that accompany each film, shape the music direction and arrangement, art-direct the visuals, and then select, sequence, and edit everything into the final work.

Every film begins with a feeling, an idea, or a question I want to explore. From there, the story, writing, music, and visual world gradually take shape.
